baseline_models.focus_anchor: yukallimahu, the three illa/aw routes, bi-idhnihi, and ma yasha
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception series partitions divine-human communication into hidden delivery, screened address, and a dispatched carrier; permission and will keep source, channel, and content under one authority.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech connecting speakers establishes the relation being channelled.
Hidden conveyance supplies both the first route and the messenger's relayed act.
An interposed screen distinguishes mediated address from unbounded direct contact.
A message and its carrier form the third communicative interface.
Permission makes the relay authorized rather than self-originating.
Will governs what the authorized channel conveys.

changed_reading.before: A general denial followed by miscellaneous exceptions.
changed_reading.after: A controlled interface taxonomy in which channel, carrier, authorization, and content remain distinct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: li-basharin, min wara'i hijabin, and aliyyun
baseline_models.mechanism: The visibly surfaced human receiver stands on one side of a concealed boundary while the source retains hierarchical elevation; mediation crosses the boundary without erasing the asymmetry.

activation_trace.role: Visible skin and surface make the human the exposed receiving side of the relation.
The other side of a barrier supplies relational distance without requiring simple physical behindness.
Blocked access preserves the boundary that mediated communication traverses.
Rank and elevation close the verse by preserving source-receiver asymmetry.

changed_reading.before: The veil is only an obstacle to direct speech.
changed_reading.after: The veil marks an interface across unequal levels, allowing reception while preserving concealed otherness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wound branch of k-l-m beside hijab, idhn, and hakim
baseline_models.mechanism: If speech-contact can be imagined through the wound branch of k-l-m as incisive contact, screen, permission, and wise restraint become safeguards around an encounter rather than signs of communicative deficiency.

activation_trace.role: A bodily wound supplies the exploratory image of contact that leaves a mark.
Prevention of access functions as protection around potentially incisive contact.
Permission regulates when mediated contact may proceed.
Restraint that prevents harm for repair gives the restrictions a protective function.

changed_reading.before: Indirect modes are lesser substitutes for direct speech.
changed_reading.after: Indirect modes may be wise safeguards that make transformative contact receivable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early repetition of revelation to the present addressee and those before him turns the focus taxonomy into a recurring relay across recipients and times.

activation_trace.role: Divine inspiration and messenger-borne disclosure anchor the focus routes.
The same divine-disclosure branch explicitly recurs for the present recipient.
Temporal precedence extends that recurrence to earlier recipients.

structural_cues: 42:3 opens the rooted discourse with yuhī and closes with hakim, both repeated in 42:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated w-h-y and 'before you'; I infer continuity of one authorized relay across recipients, while the live alternative is a formulaic comparison without channel implications.

changed_reading.after: 42:51 codifies a recurrent divine mode that remains stable across changing human recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-splitting heavens under pressure from above, followed by angelic activity, activates the veil and messenger as a regulated boundary that bears communicative pressure.

activation_trace.role: The screening barrier supplies the load-bearing boundary in the focus.
The carrier supplies a controlled passage across that boundary.
Opening and splitting provide the packet's image of a boundary under strain.
Direction from above supplies the pressure orientation without fixing a literal divine location.
Angelic actors occupy the mediating zone immediately after the threatened split.

structural_cues: 42:5 places near-fracture from above beside angelic praise and intercession; 42:51 ends with aliyy and hakim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strained upper boundary and mediating angels; I infer that screen and messenger regulate what a finite receiver can bear, while the live alternative is that hijab only denotes concealment.

changed_reading.before: The three modes form a scale ranked mainly by directness.
changed_reading.after: The mediated modes function as load-managed interfaces that preserve both contact and the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere in the surah, word-language is joined to precedence, decisive separation, erasure of falsehood, and establishment of truth; divine speaking therefore carries performative force as well as information.

activation_trace.role: Speech between speakers anchors the performative extension in the focus verb.
A meaningful word is the object associated with an already operative precedence.
Precedence makes the cited word function before the delayed judgment.
Decisive separation gives the repeated word a judging operation.
Erasure supplies one world-changing effect associated with divine words.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the complementary constructive effect.

structural_cues: Kalima or kalimat recurs at 42:14, 42:21, and 42:24 in clauses governing judgment and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies words associated with prior force, separation, erasure, and truth-establishment; I transfer that performative capacity to yukallimahu, while the live alternative keeps decree-language distinct from communicative speech.

changed_reading.before: God's speaking primarily transfers propositions to a human.
changed_reading.after: Authorized divine speech can also enact delay, distinction, removal, and establishment in its recipient world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's rejection of prescriptions not authorized by God makes bi-idhnihi a provenance boundary: a carrier's relay counts as divine communication only under source authorization.

activation_trace.role: Permission explicitly authenticates the messenger's act in the focus.
Negated authorization supplies the contrast case of an invalidly sourced prescription.
Entering and instituting an affair shows the unauthorized output becoming operative.
Decisive judgment preserves the distinction between authorized and rival claims.

structural_cues: 42:21 pairs lam ya'dhan bihi Allah with rival prescription; 42:51 pairs bi-idhnihi with the messenger's relay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative authorization test and a positive messenger authorization; I infer source authentication, while the live alternative limits 42:21 to law rather than communication.

changed_reading.before: By His permission is ceremonial assent after a messenger is chosen.
changed_reading.after: By His permission is the provenance control that prevents mediated speech from acquiring an independent source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close formula yunzilu bi-qadarin ma yasha maps will onto measured descent, revising the focus so ma yasha governs dose, timing, and form of communication, not content alone.

activation_trace.role: Will governs what passes through the authorized focus channel.
Expansion and abundance establish the danger of an unmeasured allotment.
Measured provision is delivered downward, supplying an analogy for controlled delivery.
A bounded amount supplies the calibrating mechanism.
The matching will formula directly joins chosen measure to delivery.

structural_cues: 42:27 states yunzilu bi-qadarin ma yasha; 42:51 states fa-yuhi bi-idhnihi ma yasha.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching delivery, measure, and will syntax; I infer that revelation too is receiver-fitted allotment, while the live alternative treats the match as a general sovereignty formula.

changed_reading.before: Ma yasha selects only the message's propositional content.
changed_reading.after: Ma yasha selects a measured communicative dose, timing, and interface fitted to the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sent addressee in 42:48 is explicitly denied guardianship and assigned only delivery, sharpening the focus messenger as a carrier whose authority and content remain upstream.

activation_trace.role: The focus names both the message relation and its carrier.
Being dispatched supplies the parallel sent-agent relation.
Negated guardianship removes control over recipients from the sent agent.
Delivery of the message positively defines the agent's limited function.

structural_cues: 42:48 contrasts ma arsalnaka ... hafizan with illa al-balag immediately before the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, denied guardianship, and delivery; I infer a carrier-not-controller rule for 42:51, while the live alternative distinguishes the human envoy in 42:48 from the messenger in the focus.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is simply one of three ways God speaks.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is a bounded relay: sent and effective in delivery, but neither source nor controller of reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding distribution of offspring and barrenness frames human configurations as bestowed under will; the focus then treats communicative receptivity likewise as configured access rather than a native human entitlement.

activation_trace.role: The human species term anchors the shift from generated embodiment to communicative capacity.
Will governs the content and route available to the human receiver.
Gift without exchange supplies the model of capacities that cannot be claimed as entitlement.
Repeated will governs differentiated bestowal immediately before the focus.
Blocked generative receptivity supplies the contrast that makes access contingent rather than inherent.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 repeat yasha across gifted offspring and barrenness; 42:51 immediately repeats ma yasha after naming bashar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent bestowed and blocked human generativity under repeated will; I infer an analogy to bestowed communicative receptivity, while the live alternative treats 42:51 as a clean topical transition.

changed_reading.before: A human naturally has direct-access capacity that is merely restricted.
changed_reading.after: Human receptivity itself is bestowed and configured, so access arrives only in the mode granted to the receiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies the disclosed medium as spirit from the command, then light and guidance to a straight path; the focus channels therefore deliver an effect that animates, makes knowable, and directs.

activation_trace.role: Divine disclosure anchors the transition into the next ayah.
The repeated disclosure verb carries the focus mechanism directly forward.
Life-bearing spirit supplies an animating effect of the disclosure.
The originating command keeps the disclosed medium tied to its source.
Illumination turns hidden transfer into perceptible understanding.
Gentle direction converts received disclosure into guided movement.
The straight path gives that directional effect a traversable outcome.

structural_cues: 42:52 immediately repeats awhayna after 42:51 and moves from prior non-knowing to light and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spirit, command, light, guidance, and path as predicates or effects around repeated revelation; I infer a life-giving epistemic transformation, while the live alternative treats them as descriptions of one revealed object rather than every channel.

changed_reading.before: The channels terminate when a message reaches a human.
changed_reading.after: Authorized transfer culminates in animation, illumination, and directed movement within the receiver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a judgment-scene's hidden sidelong glance onto communication; it remains anchored in hijab's eye-shading and edge imagery plus wara's other side, but downstream prose should present it only as an optical analogy, not a physical description of divine speech.

activation_trace.role: The other side of a barrier supplies concealed relational depth.
An eyebrow that shields the eye supplies a filtering rather than wholly opaque barrier.
An edge or extremity supplies the narrow aperture of partial reception.
Hiddenness keeps the oblique glimpse within concealment.

changed_reading.before: A veil is an opaque wall that only subtracts directness.
changed_reading.after: A veil may function like a controlled aperture, permitting partial reception while preserving concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates aqim's obscure or barren-speech image from the preceding ayah; it remains anchored in yukallimahu and wahi and is worth retaining as a contrast between blocked and effect-bearing communication, but downstream prose should label it a lexical counter-image rather than a translation.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech supplies the focus-side contrast to communicative barrenness.
Hidden conveyance still reaches another and therefore bears communicative effect.
Obscure barren speech supplies the immediately adjacent negative counter-image.

changed_reading.before: The listed channels are neutral alternatives for moving speech.
changed_reading.after: Authorized mediation is effect-bearing speech, contrasted exploratorily with utterance whose channel is closed or barren.

strongest_changes: Permission became a provenance boundary rather than ceremonial assent.
Repeated kalima and kalimat contexts made divine speaking performative as well as informative.
The 42:27 syntax made will govern measured dose, timing, and interface.
42:48 and 42:52 separated carrier from controller and supplied illumination and guidance as communicative effects.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed exact verbal echoes around authorization, measure, delivery, and immediate sequence; it also preserved the stranger protective, aperture, and barren-speech activations without forcing them into the strongest model.
remaining_uncertainties: The pressure-regulating veil depends on transferring the near-splitting image of 42:5 to the focus boundary.
The bestowed-receptivity model depends on treating 42:49-50 as a framing sequence rather than a completed topic.
The performative force of kalima and kalimat may not transfer fully to the interpersonal form yukallimahu.
